harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: node1 now serves HTTPS on port 8443 using nginx. A persistent systemd timer checks the 30-day node-generated certificate daily, renews it seven days before expiry, and gracefully reloads nginx. Rotation completed with 100/100 requests succeeding, and the configuration survived a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Installed and enabled nginx on node1.
Generated a self-signed certificate and private key on node1.
Configured HTTPS on IPv4 and IPv6 port 8443.
Installed and enabled the persistent cert-rotate-8443 systemd timer.
Forced a certificate rotation and verified uninterrupted requests plus immediate use of the new certificate.
Safely rebooted node1 once and verified service, certificate, listener, and timer recovery.

evidence.summary: nginx is active and enabled, listens on port 8443, and returns the expected response with certificate validation before and after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Renew the certificate automatically before expiry
evidence.summary: The enabled, active, persistent daily timer has a scheduled next run; the renewal logic retains certificates outside the seven-day renewal window.

evidence.requirement: Pick up each new certificate while continuing to answer requests
evidence.summary: The certificate serial changed from 0E5B…7202 to 13AC…233A, the nginx master PID remained unchanged during graceful reload, all 100 concurrent HTTPS requests succeeded, and the served serial matched the new certificate.

Captured the healthy baseline and original boot ID, received safe reboot scheduling acknowledgement, observed boot ID change from 96c08b66… to 2fec470c…, and verified nginx, the renewal timer, port 8443, HTTPS content, and the persisted certificate fully recovered.
